findings.title: No EMC filtering near J2
findings.description: Connector J2 (K26_SOM240_2_GTH_BANK224_BOUNDARY) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J2. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J5

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J4

findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J4. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J1
findings.description: Connector J1 (XC7K160T_DDR_GTX_BANK_BOUNDARY_NO_BGA_PINS) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J1. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J4
findings.description: J4 (XC7K160T_JTAG_CONFIG_BOUNDARY) has 1 ground pin(s) for 9 signal pins. Recommended: at least 3 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J4 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J1
findings.description: J1 (XC7K160T_DDR_GTX_BANK_BOUNDARY_NO_BGA_PINS) has 1 ground pin(s) for 79 signal pins. Recommended: at least 20 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J1 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.

findings.title: Clock /GTH_REFCLK1_N on outer layer
findings.description: Clock net /GTH_REFCLK1_N is 100% routed on outer layers (microstrip). Inner stripline layers provide better shielding from radiation.
findings.recommendation: Route clock signals on inner layers (stripline) when possible.

findings.title: Clock /GTH_REFCLK0_P on outer layer
findings.description: Clock net /GTH_REFCLK0_P is 100% routed on outer layers (microstrip). Inner stripline layers provide better shielding from radiation.

findings.title: Clock /GTH_REFCLK0_N routed near connector J2
findings.description: Clock net /GTH_REFCLK0_N passes within 8.2mm of connector J2. Clock harmonics can couple to attached cables via proximity, increasing radiated emissions.
findings.recommendation: Route /GTH_REFCLK0_N away from J2, or add ground guard traces between the clock and connector.

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (140×110mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 510 MHz; (0,1) at 650 MHz; (1,1) at 826 MHz; (2,0) at 1021 MHz; (2,1) at 1210 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
